notes.title: Cumulative Update Announcement for Versions v1.0.3 to v1.0.5
notes.content: [p]Starting from version v1.0.3, we have completed a major update plan through three consecutive updates. As of the latest version v1.0.5, compared to the initial release version of the game, we have added the following:[/p][p][/p][p][i]1.Equipment Modification System[/i][/p][p][i]2.A series of new horse racing gameplay features[/i][/p][p][i]3.A series of new apartment gameplay features for players[/i][/p][p][i]4.New sports activities in the gym[/i][/p][p][i]5.Multiple new rules and action optimizations for the combat section of talent shows[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We are delighted to see the game gradually achieve our vision after multiple updates: to simulate more aspects of a specific character's life, not just fighting and runway performances. When this major update plan is completed, we look forward to the next plan. Fighting and performances will still be the core, but they will no longer be runway shows. Life content will also be enriched, and experiencing a more outrageous character career with players and deriving fun from it remains our highest goal.[/p][p][/p][p]For details on previously completed updates, please refer to the previous update notes. Here, we mainly introduce the updates in the latest version v1.0.5, which include:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Player Apartments[/b][/p][p]Now you can enter your apartment from the main map, purchase furniture items to place in your room, or replace wallpaper, lighting, and more. In addition to ordinary cabinets and countertops for placing items, most furniture comes with its own functions. Using these furniture items may randomly trigger attribute boosts for your character. Moreover, after winning competitions, there is a chance to receive furniture and item rewards for your apartment. These rewards will directly appear in the apartment's inventory and are usually unavailable for purchase in stores but can be sold for money, providing a new way for characters to earn income.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Horse Racing Scene[/b][/p][p]A new optional scene has been added to horse racing. This scene features random portals that add drama to the races, as well as reward money cards that can be picked up by characters. Players need to reach floating platforms via random teleportation and control their horses to touch rotating cards to win rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Recovery Actions in Combat[/b][/p][p]We noticed that some hit/knockdown animations might last too long. To preserve their dramatic effect, we did not remove or modify these animations but added recovery actions. Now, before standing up after being hit, pressing the back jump button (Space on the keyboard or LB on the controller) can immediately break the hit state and return to a normal stance. You should be able to grasp the specifics by trying it out. If you encounter any issues, feel free to submit them in the discussion or feedback section.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Scene Lighting Adjustments[/b][/p][p]We have fine-tuned or re-baked the lighting for most scenes. Previously, some areas made characters appear overly dark, but this has been mostly resolved.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Horse Riding Achievement[/b][/p][p]A new horse riding achievement has been added, which can be unlocked after winning ten horse races.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixed Hit Bubble Display Issue[/b][/p][p]The two types of hit bubble interfaces during combat will now appear in more accurate positions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mini-map Added to the Main Map Scene[/b][/p][p]We have added a permanent mini-map to the main map scene to address the inconvenience caused by the increasing number of buildings in use.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With the end of the summer sale, we have slightly increased the retail price of the game after this update. The price adjustment is mainly aimed at better supporting the development of future updates and long-term game maintenance. In the future, as more game content is released with new plans, we will continue to fine-tune the price to sustain the momentum of development and maintenance.[/p][p][/p][p]On the other hand, to balance the interests of players who have not yet purchased the game and allow as many players as possible to enjoy the game at the lowest possible price, we will continuously update new content to the trial version.In addition, we plan to release several game bundles with long-term discounts in the near future, hoping to provide more options for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we sincerely hope you enjoy the game and find more joy in it. We always welcome your feedback and suggestions. Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience![/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: 1.Equipment Modification System
2.A series of new horse racing gameplay features
3.A series of new apartment gameplay features for players
4.New sports activities in the gym
5.Multiple new rules and action optimizations for the combat section of talent shows

Now you can enter your apartment from the main map, purchase furniture items to place in your room, or replace wallpaper, lighting, and more. In addition to ordinary cabinets and countertops for placing items, most furniture comes with its own functions. Using these furniture items may randomly trigger attribute boosts for your character. Moreover, after winning competitions, there is a chance to receive furniture and item rewards for your apartment. These rewards will directly appear in the apartment's inventory and are usually unavailable for purchase in stores but can be sold for money, providing a new way for characters to earn income.

A new optional scene has been added to horse racing. This scene features random portals that add drama to the races, as well as reward money cards that can be picked up by characters. Players need to reach floating platforms via random teleportation and control their horses to touch rotating cards to win rewards.

We noticed that some hit/knockdown animations might last too long. To preserve their dramatic effect, we did not remove or modify these animations but added recovery actions. Now, before standing up after being hit, pressing the back jump button (Space on the keyboard or LB on the controller) can immediately break the hit state and return to a normal stance. You should be able to grasp the specifics by trying it out. If you encounter any issues, feel free to submit them in the discussion or feedback section.

tags.bug: We have fine-tuned or re-baked the lighting for most scenes. Previously, some areas made characters appear overly dark, but this has been mostly resolved.

tags.feature: A new horse riding achievement has been added, which can be unlocked after winning ten horse races.

tags.bug: The two types of hit bubble interfaces during combat will now appear in more accurate positions.

tags.feature: We have added a permanent mini-map to the main map scene to address the inconvenience caused by the increasing number of buildings in use.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531236/c980eedc5ec01ed16113312df413df25c862fa83.png"][/img][/p][h3]Main Update Contents[/h3][olist][*][p]Some one-handed and two-handed weapon attack animations have been replaced. The new attack motions are slightly faster and visually more distinct than before.[/p][/*][*][p]Three new types of gems have been added, which can be obtained as rewards in horse racing competitions. A new building, the "Goddess Algorithm," has also been added to the world map, where gems can be used to modify equipment. Detailed rules can be found in the relevant interface.[/p][/*][*][p]A new upgrade item card has been introduced, available as a reward in horse racing competitions. When placed in the auxiliary slot during equipment upgrades, this card does not increase the success rate but prevents equipment from being destroyed if the upgrade fails. The card is consumable and will be used up regardless of whether the upgrade succeeds or fails.[/p][/*][*][p]A new “Rage” status has been added to competitions. Now, if a player who has already earned points is knocked out again shortly after reviving, they will enter a rage state. Players in rage will no longer participate in the match, and attacking a raging enemy allows you to steal her points. If her points drop below 10, the rage status is removed.[/p][/*][*][p]A new item, tape, can now be brought into matches. It can be used on defeated enemies within a certain range to tie them up and restrict their actions. If another enemy passes by the tied-up enemy, the binding will be released.[/p][/*][*][p]A balance ball activity has been added to the gym, with rules similar to other activities.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Added detection for character position overlap during battles. Attacks will no longer fail due to overlapping positions with enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display and selling bugs related to the bottom row of items in the company backpack.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Update and Promotion Plan[/h3][p]This update (V1.0.4), like the previous one, is part of a larger ongoing update plan. Several more updates will follow as part of this major update, including new content and scene effect optimizations. The main new content will be the player character’s home. After completing this major update, a new competition mode—on par with the current beauty contest—will be included in the next major update plan.[/p]

tags.feature: Three new types of gems have been added, which can be obtained as rewards in horse racing competitions. A new building, the "Goddess Algorithm," has also been added to the world map, where gems can be used to modify equipment. Detailed rules can be found in the relevant interface.

A new upgrade item card has been introduced, available as a reward in horse racing competitions. When placed in the auxiliary slot during equipment upgrades, this card does not increase the success rate but prevents equipment from being destroyed if the upgrade fails. The card is consumable and will be used up regardless of whether the upgrade succeeds or fails.

A new “Rage” status has been added to competitions. Now, if a player who has already earned points is knocked out again shortly after reviving, they will enter a rage state. Players in rage will no longer participate in the match, and attacking a raging enemy allows you to steal her points. If her points drop below 10, the rage status is removed.

A new item, tape, can now be brought into matches. It can be used on defeated enemies within a certain range to tie them up and restrict their actions. If another enemy passes by the tied-up enemy, the binding will be released.
A balance ball activity has been added to the gym, with rules similar to other activities.

tags.bug: Added detection for character position overlap during battles. Attacks will no longer fail due to overlapping positions with enemies.
Fixed display and selling bugs related to the bottom row of items in the company backpack.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531236/338a651cefb264db8d0bd0a443d4e91a5a2229e7.png"][/img][/p][p]The main highlight of this version is the addition of new gameplay in the Riders' Den. This new feature aligns with our previous ambitions—we wanted to explore and experiment with more absurd and exaggerated content, and we hope we haven’t gone too far. As this is a brand new feature, there may be some areas that are not yet fully polished. We warmly welcome your feedback in the discussion area, whether it’s suggestions, issues, or simply sharing your thoughts. All forms of feedback are greatly appreciated.[/p][p][/p][p]Version 1.0.3 is part of a larger update. The Riders' Den will continue to be improved in the next version, and there may be other new content as well. Many of the suggestions and issues raised by everyone that haven’t been addressed yet will also be gradually implemented in the upcoming updates. In short, the series of updates starting from 1.0.3 are continuous and share the same goal. Once everything is complete, we will release a comprehensive review.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other changes and improvements in this version:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]You can now sell other types of items at the brokerage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed two minor bugs with the bar counter tasks introduced in the previous version.[/p][/*][*][p]Added navigation cues in the world map scene. If there are other functional buildings in a given direction, an icon will now appear to notify you.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you again for all your suggestions and feedback in the discussion area. We sincerely look forward to hearing more from you.[/p][p]Have fun playing![/p]

tags.feature: You can now sell other types of items at the brokerage.

tags.bug: Fixed two minor bugs with the bar counter tasks introduced in the previous version.

tags.feature: Added navigation cues in the world map scene. If there are other functional buildings in a given direction, an icon will now appear to notify you.

notes.title: v1.0.2 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531236/b6d0e643e4aef31a148a563cad6bcd6f63edbb79.png[/img]

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]

[b]Bartending Task[/b] — In arenas with a bar, you can now collect an employee card at the bar and sell drinks to guests on the purple sofa. Follow the button prompts on the progress bar to increase the guest's favorability and sell more drinks. Pressing the button when prompted not to will decrease favorability.

[b]Plastic Surgery Updates[/b] — The plastic surgery hospital can now adjust larger chest and hip sizes (as requested by players, though developers think it's already too large). Additionally, a new blue skin is available.

[b]Weapon Usage Count[/b] — A new combat bonus effect is added for achieving Weapon Master milestones. After unlocking a weapon's achievement, using it in a level grants 1.5x damage output. Additionally, you can view weapon usage progress in the personal attributes section of the agency interface in map scenes.

[b]New Achievement[/b] — A new bathing achievement has been added. It unlocks after taking 10 baths.

[b]Equipment Upgrade Success Rate[/b] — The rules for calculating the success rate of equipment upgrades have been modified. After each success, the reduction in success rate for the next attempt is lessened. Additionally, a probability stacking mechanism is introduced: as long as you remain in the shop interface, each failed upgrade slightly increases the success rate for the next item. This increase accumulates until an item is successfully upgraded. Successful upgrades and leaving the shop interface reset this accumulated success rate. This property is not included in the displayed success rate. For example, if the interface shows a 50% success rate, but the previous item's upgrade failed, the actual success rate for the current item might be 53%.

[b]Hair Loss in Battle[/b] — Hair can now be knocked off during battles. The probability of losing hair is lower than that of losing shoes.


[h3]Bug Fixes and Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where the message "It's your turn to perform" would incorrectly display when entering levels.
2. Resolved a problem where characters could move during stage performance actions added in the previous update.
3. Adjusted the default target selection method in levels. Now, after entering a level, targets are selected based on direction by default.
4. Updated the handling logic for switching between mouse and controller operations in the TV station and photography studio interfaces. The focus now defaults to the first job/competition list option.
5. Fixed an issue where characters could not walk properly when switching between battle and idle states in certain situations.
6. Updated the chat content of gym livestream viewers, correcting dialogues that did not match the livestream content.
7. Recovered weapons and items that fell out of the scene in extreme cases.
8. Fixed an issue where characters' hair or clothing would disappear upon exiting the gym.


[h3]Preview of the Next Update:[/h3]

With the current round of level modifications nearing completion, the focus will shift to a brand-new gameplay feature in the next update. While some details and new feedback will still be addressed, the primary content of the next version will revolve around this new gameplay system.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531236/a9feed88508ed6d6154c2eb4871155aae5f08b11.png[/img]

[b]Update Details[/b]
1. New Gameplay Features

Gym: A new gym feature is added where players can work out to enhance character attributes. The workout process will be virtually streamed, allowing players to earn cash through viewer gifts.

Lucky Shop: The game now includes a Lucky Shop where players can spend money to purchase items and equipment with unknown attributes.

Game Achievements: Achievements are now available, primarily unlocked based on weapon usage.

2. Gameplay Changes and Improvements

Electric Box: New electric box objects are added in levels. Destroying them causes a blackout, ending the match early.

Performance Actions: New stage performance actions for characters have been added, offering more variety than just repeating the same pose.

Disable Rotating Mirror Ball Lights: The option to disable rotating mirror ball lights in certain levels has been added.

Medication for Concussion: Taking medication can now cure concussions.

Skip Stunned Competitor Entry Wait: If a player is not wearing a mask and the current competitor is stunned, the wait time for entry will be skipped to speed up the level.

3. Combat-Related Updates

Target Selection Method: In the level pause menu, players can choose the target selection method: nearest target, facing target, or a mix of distance and facing direction.

Character and Weapon Attack Skill Judgement: Adjustments have been made to the attack range and target count for characters and weapons to enhance gameplay experience.

Revised Backward Leap Logic: Characters will now only leap backward relative to themselves, not based on the combat target.

4. Other Game Optimizations

Fixed Performance Order in First Level: The performance order in the first level is now fixed, with the player appearing third.

Collision Blocking: Minor adjustments to collision blocking in certain areas.

Real-Time Controller and Keyboard/Mouse Switch Check: Real-time checks for switching between controller and keyboard/mouse have been added to most interfaces. Accidental touches on the keyboard/mouse while using a controller will not cause the interface to lose focus.

Adjusted Item Icons: Some item icons have been fine-tuned for a more aesthetically pleasing interface.
